newsitem.title: USA: MICROAGE SIGNS AGREEMENT WITH AT&T.
newsitem.headline: MICROAGE SIGNS AGREEMENT WITH AT&T.

text.p: MicroAge Inc said Friday it signed an agreement with AT&T Corp allowing computer resellers to become agents for its wireless data service.
As AT&T agents, MicroAge said its resellers will help to promote the company's services, provide customer support and configure equipment that is used by customers to access wireless networks.
Resellers will be paid commissions and other payments resulting from activation fees and other services.
MicroAge was not immediately able to provide information on potential revenues from the agreement.
